passages.locus: Section 1.5, Definition 1.13, notes and Example 1.20 opening
passages.context: Conditional probability of A given B is defined by the intersection probability divided by the probability of B, explicitly requiring P(B)>0.
passages.supports: An independently authored Indonesian university text uses B90's current designation for the same conditional-probability concept.
passages.does_not_establish: National preference, a register hierarchy, or applicability to all B90 occurrences. The nearby zero-probability note overstates impossibility in general and is not adopted.
passages.visual_comparison: Root read the complete extracted page and original page render, including conditional bars, intersection, denominator condition and surrounding note.

passages.locus: Example 1.20, aircraft and die conditional-probability calculations
passages.context: The examples condition arrival on departure, departure on arrival, and a die result on odd parity. The die calculation compares an unconditional one-half with a conditional two-thirds.
passages.supports: The preceding definition is used in actual exposition; conditioning is not restricted to an event that happens later in time.
passages.does_not_establish: A separate preferred-form vote, exhaustive mathematical certification, or measured learner understanding.
passages.visual_comparison: Root read the complete original page and checked both aircraft conditionals and the die calculation. The card question beginning below is not adjudicated.

passages.context: The phrase labels P(B)=1/3 while contrasting it with conditional posterior probabilities. The named quantity in this occurrence is the unconditional prior.
passages.supports: A concrete counterexample to admitting an exact lexical search hit as contextual terminology evidence.
passages.does_not_establish: That the phrase is generally wrong: the separate UAD Definition 1.3 supports it. The neighboring numerical posterior and clinical example are not certified here.
passages.visual_comparison: Root read the complete original page and checked the absence of a conditioning bar in the quantity labelled by this phrase.

impact_inventory.relationship: Supported by separate UAD definition, not by the defective ULM page-38 occurrence.

decision.rationale: ULM Definition 1.13 and UAD Definition 1.3 independently attest the two existing designations for the same concept. Their difference alone is not evidence of mistranslation. The malformed ULM prior label is not counted as same-sense support.
decision.confidence: High editorial confidence in the narrow definition comparison after original-page inspection; not a calibrated probability or national usage claim.
decision.next_evidence: Compare source and translated occurrences linked to B90 R010-TERM-0060 and D30 O009-T0233, preserving formula conditions, before any context-specific revision.
